verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Google has APIs (Directory API user list/create, Cloud Identity API 'for provisioning and managing identity resources') that could technically let an external HRIS push joiner/mover/leaver changes into the Workspace directory, but the only explicitly documented provisioning flow is the reverse direction — Workspace automatically pushing user changes OUT to a third-party app (e.g., Office 365) — not an HRIS feeding Workspace. No documentation of a native HRIS/SCIM inbound connector, JML automation, or app-assignment sync driven by an HR source of truth. Missing for 10: a documented inbound SCIM/HRIS integration, explicit JML workflow automation, and evidence that app assignments update automatically from HR-driven directory changes.
